name: Glitch Image Effect
description: Full-screen hero image with periodic RGB-split glitch bursts made of clipped, offset and tinted image layers, plus a large title that glitches in sync.
contents: Full-viewport background image stacked in five layers
behavior: Three clipped layers jump sideways and flipped with stepped clip-path slices on a looping timer
A tinted flash layer pulses at the start of each glitch
Title glitches shortly after the image layers
Animation starts once the image has loaded and stops with reduced motion
editableByProps: Image, title text, background and title colors, title size, position and font
Glitch offset distances, loop duration and delay, tint colors and blend modes, flash strength

needsCodeEdit.where: @keyframes ${uid}-a1 block in the css template literal

fixed: Bungee font is referenced by default but not imported; host must load it or pass titleFont
Root is full-bleed and sized by height and width props, no extra frame
